title: A Study About Low Blood Pressure in Patients With Primary Immunodeficiency Disease Treated With Immune Globulin Products
brief_summary: This is a safety study to evaluate the risk of low blood pressure in subjects with Primary Immune Deficiency disorder (PID) treated with Bivigam™ or another commercial product under real world conditions. No study medication will be provided to subjects in this study. Study physicians will make all treatment decisions according to their usual practice and will provide prescriptions for his/her subjects, as appropriate. The only addition is the collection and structured documentation of data generated through usual practice.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with PID diagnosis
* Current subjects requiring treatment with an IGIV

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients not meeting inclusion criteria
study_population: Patients with primary immunodeficiency disease treated IGIV products.
